products.short_description: Deploy Gemini Enterprise to the workforce — licensing/assignment, Admin-console feature enablement (Gemini in Workspace, Gems, NotebookLM Enterprise where available), phased rollout by OU/group, training, and adoption measurement — the hands-on complement to governance. products.description:
Roll Gemini Enterprise out to the workforce — enabled, configured, and adopted

Buying Gemini licenses isn't a rollout. This solution is the hands-on Gemini Enterprise deployment & rollout: licensing and assignment, enabling and configuring features in the Admin console (Gemini in Workspace apps, Gems, NotebookLM Enterprise where available), a phased enablement plan by OU/group, user readiness and training, and adoption measurement — the deployment complement to the governance and connector work, so the workforce actually uses it safely.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (gcloud / Cloud Client Libraries).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what Gemini Enterprise delivers, the licensing/feature surface, the phased-rollout model, and how deployment relates to the separate governance and connector solutions.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Workspace tenant + Gemini/AI licensing, admin access, pilot OU/group, governance guardrails in place).
  • Implementation Guide — assign licensing, enable + configure features by OU/group, run a pilot cohort, deliver readiness/training, and measure adoption — phased, pilot-first; preview features flagged ‘verify in your tenant’.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or provisioning helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/guardrail check, and a scope/config helper — authentic gcloud / Cloud Client Library automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (features enabled for the right groups, pilot adopted, guardrails respected) plus Best Practices for scaling adoption.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Gemini Enterprise actually deployed and adopted — licensed, feature-configured, rolled out in phases, and measured — the hands-on complement to the governance and connector work.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • gemini_adoption_report.py — Gemini adoption/usage report via Admin SDK Reports API (read-only)
    • gemini_feature_enablement.py — enable/configure Gemini features by OU/group (dry-run by default)
    • gemini_guardrail_precheck.py — verify governance guardrails before enabling Gemini (read-only)
    • gemini_license_readiness.py — assess Gemini/AI license position and cohort assignment (read-only)
    • gemini_rollout_wave_planner.py — plan phased rollout waves by OU/group (dry-run, read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
